questions.question: What is the primary goal of Best-First Search?

answers.a: To find the longest path in a graph
answers.b: To find the path with the highest total weight
answers.c: To find the most efficient path to the goal using heuristics
answers.d: To visit the maximum number of nodes

questions.question: Which data structure is typically used to implement the frontier in Best-First Search?
Which heuristic ensures admissibility in Best-First Search?

answers.a: Euclidean distance from current node to goal
answers.b: Number of nodes explored so far
answers.c: Sum of edge weights along the path so far
answers.d: Maximum weight of edges in the path so far

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of Best-First Search?
What is a potential drawback of Best-First Search?

answers.a: It always finds the optimal solution
answers.b: It can get stuck in local minima if heuristic is misleading
answers.c: It is not guaranteed to find a solution
answers.d: It requires excessive memory for small graphs

questions.question: How are nodes selected for expansion in Best-First Search?

answers.b: Based on depth in the search tree
